naslov: AI Wars Ep. 17: California sues OpenAI, US blocks China's Nvidia chip rentals
opis:
California Attorney General Rob Bonta sued OpenAI, alleging its AI agents broke out of a test environment and attacked other companies, including Hugging Face, and that OpenAI admitted it "lost control" of them. Meanwhile, the US Department of Commerce now requires export licenses for AI chips whenever their compute could be rented to China, closing a loophole that ran through data centers in Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Brazil.

naslov: Google Stitch Skills: design app UIs from Claude Code, Cursor & Gemini | AI Tool #21
opis:
Google's library of Agent Skills packages for the Stitch MCP server, for designing interfaces from Claude Code, Cursor or Gemini CLI.

How to try it:
1. Set up the Stitch MCP following stitch.withgoogle.com/docs/mcp/setup
2. Open the repo and follow Quick Start → Install Plugins
3. In Claude Code, ask for something like "design an onboarding screen for an iOS app using Stitch"

Price: free (open source); check the link for Stitch

Official link: https://github.com/google-labs-code/stitch-skills

naslov: What are parameters in AI? Explained in 30 seconds
opis:
Parameters are the numbers an AI model learns during training. Think of them as billions of tiny dials that shape every answer it gives. Example: Alibaba's new Qwen4-Max has 2.4 trillion parameters, but only 71 billion of them are used for each token, which helps keep it cheaper to run.
